EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in exercise and wellness (MS EXW)
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Thank you for your interest in the Master of Science in exercise and wellness (MS EXW) program. Students who have completed the following requirements are encouraged to apply:
1. Bachelor’s degree from a regionally accredited college or university.
2. GRE scores at or above the 50th percentile.
3. Minimum GPA of 3.0.
4. Completion of the following undergraduate course deficiencies prior to or during graduate coursework. These courses are offered at ASU each semester (fall, spring, and summer) in order to facilitate completion of requirements. The undergraduate course deficiencies do not count toward the 36 credit hour graduate degree.
Undergraduate Course Deficiency
BIO 201, 202 Human Anatomy & Physiology
NTR 241 Human Nutrition
EXW 315 Physiological Foundations of Movement
EXW 330 Kinesiological Foundations of Movement
EXW 420 Exercise Testing
EXW 425 Exercise Prescription
Fall applications are available on the website as of September. Review of applications begins on January 15 and continues as long as space is available.
Review the program description for general information about the program and visit our frequently asked questions page for details on deficiency course requirements, application processes and student information. Typically students take 2 years (4 semesters) to complete the program. You can use our cost calculator to estimate the cost of your attendance, based on current tuition/fees.
Again, thank you for your interest in the Master of Science in exercise and wellness program. Please contact me if you have any additional questions.
Thank you,
Sue Callahan, MEd
